confirm.title: Potluck hub found
confirm.description:
Home Assistant found the Potluck hub of the cell **{system}** (cell id {cell}) at {address}.

When you submit, the hub asks its owner for approval. Then, on the PC that runs the hub, open the hub's dashboard ({dashboard}) and approve **{name}** on the hub's card. Home Assistant gets read-only access to the hub's view of the cell.

user.title: Add a Potluck hub
user.description: Use this when Home Assistant does not find the hub by itself. The hub must run with `--listen` (for example `--listen 0.0.0.0:8443`) and a TLS certificate, and this Home Assistant must reach that port.

data_description.host: The address of the PC that runs the hub, for example 192.168.0.20.
data_description.port: The port in the hub's `--listen` option.

fingerprint.title: Check the hub's certificate
fingerprint.description:
The hub at {address} presented a certificate with this SHA-256 fingerprint:

`{fingerprint}`

Continue only if it is your hub's. On the PC, `openssl x509 -in <the hub's certificate file> -noout -fingerprint -sha256` prints the same digits. Home Assistant will only ever talk to this certificate.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair with the Potluck hub again
reauth_confirm.description: The hub at {address} (cell **{system}**) refused Home Assistant's token, or presented a different certificate than the one it was paired with. Submit to pair again; the owner approves on the PC that runs the hub ({dashboard}).

progress.wait_for_approval:
Waiting for the owner's approval.

On the PC that runs the hub, open the hub's dashboard ({dashboard}) and approve the request from **{name}** on the hub's card. The request expires after 5 minutes.

error.cannot_connect: Could not open a TLS connection to the hub. Check the host and port, and that the hub runs with `--listen`.

abort.already_configured: This Potluck cell is already set up.
abort.invalid_discovery: The hub's announcement was incomplete (it needs a cell id, a port and a certificate fingerprint).
abort.unsupported_api: This hub speaks a version of the hub API this integration does not know. Update the integration.
abort.no_tls: The hub announced itself without TLS. Start it with `--listen`, `--tls-cert` and `--tls-key`.
abort.pairing_denied: The owner refused the pairing on the PC. Add the hub again to ask once more.
abort.pairing_expired: Nobody approved the pairing within 5 minutes. Add the hub again, then approve the request for {name} on the hub's dashboard on the PC ({dashboard}).
abort.pairing_busy: The hub already holds 4 pairing requests waiting for an answer. Approve or refuse them on the hub's dashboard on the PC ({dashboard}), then try again.
abort.fingerprint_mismatch: The hub presented a different certificate than the one it announced. Nothing was sent to it.
abort.wrong_cell: The hub that answered is not the cell this was set up for.
abort.reauth_successful: Paired again with the Potluck hub.
